description: Supabase-backed data READS: make VendorContext fetch vendors + menu_items + categories + location_areas from Supabase with a snake_case<->camelCase mapping layer and owner-scoped write functions, then rewire the browse surfaces (Home, Search, VendorCard, VendorStore) to source categories/locationAreas/reviews from the context/tables instead of src/data. Depends on FEAT-001 (supabase client + useAuth). Leaves order/student-page rewiring to FEAT-003.
steps: Rewrite src/context/VendorContext.jsx reads: remove seedVendors/loadVendors/localStorage. On mount fetch (via the src/lib/supabase.js client) `select *` from vendors and `select *` from menu_items (both public SELECT), group menu items under their vendor, and map snake->camel to the UI shape: vendor { id, name, category, locationArea:location_area, description, hoursOpen:hours_open, hoursClose:hours_close, rating, reviews:review_count, phone, preorderEnabled:preorder_enabled, coverTint:cover_tint, logo:logo_url, cover:cover_url, menu:[{ id, name, price, category, available, desc:description, image:image_url }] }. Keep isOpenNow() and the per-minute now tick exactly as-is (the live isOpen is still derived client-side). Expose a `loading` flag; while loading provide vendors: [].

In VendorContext, also fetch categories (`select * from categories order by sort_order`) and location_areas (`select * from location_areas order by sort_order`), store them as { id, name, image } / { id, name }, and expose `categories`, `locationAreas`, and a `categoryName(id)` helper (categories.find(c=>c.id===id)?.name ?? id) on the context value.

Set currentVendorId to the logged-in vendor's owned store: consume useAuth(); find the vendor row whose owner_id === user?.id (fetch owner_id in the vendors select, or query vendors by owner_id). If none, leave it null (the Dashboard already renders a 'Store not found' state).

Rewrite the VendorContext edit functions as Supabase writes, then refresh local state (re-fetch the affected rows or optimistically patch): updateVendorInfo(id, info) -> supabase.from('vendors').update({ name, description, category, location_area, hours_open, hours_close, phone, logo_url, cover_url }).eq('id', id) mapping camel->snake and NEVER sending owner_id/rating/review_count; setPreorderEnabled(id, on) -> update { preorder_enabled: on }; saveMenuItem(id, item) -> supabase.from('menu_items').upsert({ vendor_id: id, id: item.id, name: item.name, price: item.price, category: item.category, available: item.available, description: item.desc, image_url: item.image }) (composite PK vendor_id,id); setItemAvailable(id, itemId, available) -> update { available } where vendor_id=id and id=itemId; deleteMenuItem(id, itemId) -> delete where vendor_id=id and id=itemId. Surface (console.error) RLS failures; do not swallow silently.

Replace categoryName in src/components/VendorCard.jsx, src/pages/Search.jsx, and src/pages/VendorStore.jsx: import { useVendors } and use its categoryName helper instead of importing categoryName from '../data/vendors'. (Same change pattern across three files.)

Update src/pages/Home.jsx: replace `import { categories, locationAreas } from '../data/vendors'` with the context-provided categories and locationAreas (via useVendors()). The area <select> currently does locationAreas.map(a => <option value={a}>{a}</option>) with string a; change to a.id / a.name (id===display value in the seed). Keep the vendor list from useVendors().

Rewire src/pages/VendorStore.jsx reviews (READ-ONLY here): remove getReviewsFor import. Fetch supabase.from('reviews').select('id, author_name, ordered_summary, rating, text, helpful_count, created_at').eq('vendor_id', id).order('created_at', { ascending:false }), map rows to the shape ReviewsModal expects { id, name:author_name, rating, text, ordered:ordered_summary, helpful:helpful_count, createdAt:created_at }, and pass them to ReviewsModal. The 'Ordered:' line uses ordered_summary directly (NO order_items join). rating/reviews count come from the vendor row. Empty array -> the modal's existing 'No reviews yet' state. Do NOT add review submission here.
Confirm src/context/CartContext.jsx still works unchanged (it reads menu via useVendors().getVendor). Do not alter its logic.
acceptance_criteria: VendorContext returns vendors (with menu) sourced from Supabase in the existing camelCase UI shape, exposes loading/categories/locationAreas/categoryName, and derives currentVendorId from the logged-in vendor's owner_id.
VendorContext edit functions issue Supabase vendors/menu_items writes mapped to snake_case and never send owner_id/rating/review_count.
Home/Search/VendorCard/VendorStore no longer import from src/data/vendors; VendorStore no longer imports from src/data/reviews; category labels and the Home area filter render from the tables.
VendorStore reviews render from a real reviews select (read-only), using ordered_summary for the 'Ordered:' line with no order_items join.
verification: grep -rn "data/vendors\|data/reviews" src/components/VendorCard.jsx src/pages/Home.jsx src/pages/Search.jsx src/pages/VendorStore.jsx  (no import matches)
grep -n "getReviewsFor\|order_items" src/pages/VendorStore.jsx  (no matches: reviews come from the reviews table via ordered_summary)
findings:
DONE. Build green (119 modules, exit 0 from the worktree root). Both verification greps pass: no data/vendors|data/reviews imports remain in VendorCard/Home/Search/VendorStore; no getReviewsFor and no order_items code reference in VendorStore (the only 'order_items' hit is a comment saying there is NO join). Committed as 2fe5776 (5 files). NOTE: package.json/package-lock.json are still modified+unstaged in the worktree (the @supabase/supabase-js dependency add from FEAT-001 setup) — intentionally NOT included in this commit; a later feature or the caller should decide whether to commit them. src/data/vendors.js is still imported by Dashboard.jsx (categories) and Profile.jsx (ALL_VENDORS), and src/data/reviews.js is referenced only in a ReviewsModal comment — do NOT delete the data files until FEAT-003/FEAT-004 rewire those consumers.

=== VendorContext API (import: `import { useVendors } from '../context/VendorContext'`; from src/pages or src/components the path is '../context/VendorContext') ===
useVendors() returns: { vendors, categories, locationAreas, categoryName, loading, currentVendorId, getVendor, updateVendorInfo, setPreorderEnabled, saveMenuItem, setItemAvailable, deleteMenuItem }.

SHAPES (camelCase UI, mapped from snake_case DB — mapping lives ONLY here):
  - vendor = { id, name, category, locationArea, description, hoursOpen, hoursClose, rating, reviews (=DB review_count), phone, preorderEnabled, coverTint, logo (=logo_url), cover (=cover_url), ownerId (=owner_id), menu, isOpen }. isOpen is derived client-side per-minute via isOpenNow(hoursOpen,hoursClose) — the raw stored vendor has NO isOpen; `vendors` (the exposed list) adds it.
  - menu item = { id, name, price, category, available, desc (=description), image (=image_url) }.
  - categories = [{ id, name, image }] ordered by sort_order.
  - locationAreas = [{ id, name }] ordered by sort_order. In the seed id===name (e.g. 'Food Court'). vendor.locationArea holds the id/name string; Home's area <select> now uses option value={a.id} and filters v.locationArea===area.
  - categoryName(id) => categories.find(c=>c.id===id)?.name ?? id. It's a context helper now, NOT imported from data/vendors. Replace any `import { categoryName } from '../data/vendors'` with the useVendors() helper (done in VendorCard/Search/VendorStore).

LOADING: `loading` is true until the first vendors+lookups fetch resolves; while loading `vendors` is [] (and categories/locationAreas []). Consumers that need a loading guard should read it (Dashboard/Profile in later features).

currentVendorId: derived from the logged-in vendor's owned store = rawVendors.find(v => v.ownerId && v.ownerId === user?.id)?.id ?? null. Null when no owned store (Dashboard renders its existing 'Store not found' state). VendorProvider consumes useAuth(), so it MUST stay nested inside AuthProvider (it already is in App.jsx).

EDIT FUNCTIONS (all async; issue a Supabase write mapped camel->snake, console.error on failure WITHOUT throwing, then await a full re-fetch of vendors to refresh local state). owner_id / rating / review_count are NEVER sent.
  - updateVendorInfo(id, info): info is camelCase and PARTIAL — only provided keys are mapped/sent. Accepted keys: name, description, category, locationArea(->location_area), hoursOpen(->hours_open), hoursClose(->hours_close), phone, logo(->logo_url), cover(->cover_url). (coverTint is intentionally not writable here.)
  - setPreorderEnabled(id, on) -> update { preorder_enabled: on }.
  - saveMenuItem(id, item): upsert on composite PK (vendor_id,id). item is a camelCase menu item { id, name, price, category, available, desc, image }; mapped to { vendor_id:id, id, name, price, category, available, description:desc, image_url:image }.
  - setItemAvailable(id, itemId, available) -> update { available } where vendor_id=id and id=itemId.
  - deleteMenuItem(id, itemId) -> delete where vendor_id=id and id=itemId.

REVIEWS (VendorStore, read-only): fetched directly in VendorStore (NOT via VendorContext) with supabase.from('reviews').select('id, author_name, ordered_summary, rating, text, helpful_count, created_at').eq('vendor_id', id).order('created_at',{ascending:false}), mapped to the ReviewsModal shape { id, name:author_name, rating, text, ordered:ordered_summary, helpful:helpful_count, createdAt:created_at }, passed as the `reviews` prop. No `breakdown` prop is passed anymore — ReviewsModal computes the breakdown from the list. The 'Ordered:' line uses ordered_summary directly (no order_items join). rating/reviews count still come from the vendor row (in VendorStore the vendor-row count is destructured as `reviewCount` to avoid colliding with the reviews state). FEAT-003 must add review INSERT elsewhere (Profile/OrderStatus), sending ONLY { vendor_id, order_id, rating, text }.

CartContext is unchanged and still works: it reads the menu via useVendors().getVendor(vendorId)?.menu and filters by item.available — the mapped menu keeps id/name/price/available, so no change was needed.
